messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT detected — runtime queueing spike in us-east-1 hosted API. Symptoms: sustained request_queue_length > 1200, 429s increasing from 0.5% -> 9% over 8m. Alert threshold: queue_length > 300. Paging on-call.

kevin: acked. I'm on it.

mira: ack. grabbing logs and checking per-route breakdown now. any customer known large spikes?

kevin: looks like burst from /v1/generate chat routes, a few high-concurrency clients + many small requests. prefix cache hit rate dropped.

anya: seeing elevated `inflight_per_worker` and KV cache churn in the last 10m. backend GPU metrics show kernels saturating at 100%.

sam: traffic pattern shows many concurrent 1-2 token requests from a single IP range (likely automated). Could be a buggy client.

kevin: mitigation options: 1) increase max_in_flight on runtime pool 2) enable shedding for low-priority routes 3) bump per-customer quota for impacted paying customers 4) tighten short-timeout for quick failures 5) reroute some traffic to dedicated pool if capacity available.

mira: can you try (1) and (2) quick? I'll start drafting customer comms for impacted accounts.

kevin: doing now — changing config. Command (admin console):
```
service.runtime.pools.us-east-1.update({"max_in_flight": 350})
```
Applying...

kevin: applied. Confirming runtime accepted new config. inflight target bumped from 220 -> 350.

anya: pushing shedding policy for `x-client-priority: low` to drop after queue > 200:
```
routing.shedding.add_rule({
  "match": "headers.x-client-priority == 'low'",
  "action": "reject",
  "when_queue_gt": 200
})
```
Deployed.

sam: rate limiter report: added temporary per-ip cap at 120 r/s for suspect IP range.

kevin: added an emergency route bypass for enterprise customers to avoid impact: `route.priority=high -> bypass shedding`. Doing a 30m throttle-bump for account ACME Corp via billing -> quotas API: `quota.override('acct:ACME', {requests_per_min: 6000}, ttl=1800)`

lia: quick note — reduced API idle timeout from 9s -> 6s to fail fast for stalled requests. This should free up workers faster but may increase transient 5xx for slow models.

mira: monitoring dashboards: queue_length down from 1200 -> 180 in ~4m after changes. 429s dropping to 1.2%. latency p50 improved from 420ms -> 320ms. Good signal.

kevin: rolling a small GC/evict on KV cache to restore prefix hits. command: `runtime.cache.evict_stale(30m)`

anya: cache eviction looks successful; prefix hit rate recovering from 21% -> 67%.

sam: noticed a client that keeps retrying aggressively despite 429. Can we add a Retry-After header generically?

kevin: added middleware to include `Retry-After` with 10s on 429 responses for now.

mira: assigning follow-ups:
- kevin: write quick runbook note of the emergency config changes and exact CLI steps used.
- anya: run a deeper perf check on kernel saturation and prepare a patch if kernel swap needed.
- sam: block or contact offending IPs via WAF if they keep retrying.
- lia: measure any customer error regressions from timeout drop.

kevin: heads-up — I'm handing off in 25m to mira. smoke-tested the changes.

mira: taking over. I'll keep a close eye for 1h and coordinate with support for impacted customers.

ops-bot: NOTE: incident acknowledged by kevin and mira. Severity: P2. Auto-escalation window paused.

mira: customer impact assessment: impacted customers = [ACME Corp (mitigated via quota bump), BetaLabs (saw ~6% 429s for 12m), several small free-tier accounts]. No data exfiltration. Billing/quotas impacted only request throughput.

kevin: drafted short message for support channel: "We observed transient request congestion causing 429s for some customers in us-east-1. We've applied runtime backpressure tuning and shedding and will monitor. If you see customers still affected, please DM me or @mira."

mira: posting to #support now and attaching mitigations summary.

anya: long-term action items created: increase graceful backpressure in runtime (adaptive max_in_flight based on kernel utilization), add smarter shedding based on client scoring, and add per-account adaptive quotas to prevent single noisy neighbor.

sam: also adding a detector for rapid small-request bursts per IP to auto-throttle.

mira: status update for incident channel: "mitigated — traffic shaping + config tweaks applied. Monitoring stable for 20m. Moving to post-incident triage."

kevin: LGTMe. Thanks team. I'll add the exact CLI logs to the runbook. handing off fully.

ops-bot: Incident resolved by on-call. Closing alert.

mira: scheduling a 30m postmortem sync tomorrow to go over root cause and fix plan.

kevin: ping me if you want the raw traces. I'm around for next 15m.

mira: noted. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
